name: inspira-video-text
blurb: Text fills with video, showing moving imagery only within letter shapes.
description: Masks a video element using text as an SVG shape, so video content plays only within the letterforms. Responsive sizing with configurable typography.
use_when: Hero sections or dramatic statements where video imagery inside text creates striking visual impact.
avoid_when: When video content must be described or captioned — the video is masked and not separately announced. Requires a sized container.
a11y: Text content is in a screen-reader-only span. Video itself has no captions or description; only text is announced.
